r.경제 체제: Economy wrecked by civil war · gold, livestock
r.한국이 파는 것: Vaccines, blood products 43%, Car parts 16%, Batteries 12%, Machinery, computers 8% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Plant extracts 85%, Phones, telecom equipment 13% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: A civil war between the army and the Rapid Support Forces has raged since 2023.

t.why: It is going through the world's largest humanitarian crisis; more than 10 million people have been driven from their homes.
t.rel: The army and the Rapid Support Forces have been fighting since 2023, and neighbors such as Egypt and the UAE are suspected of backing opposite sides. Millions have fled to Chad, South Sudan and Egypt. With South Sudan, which split off in 2011, oil transport and the Abyei area remain unresolved.
t.korea: Korea's foreign ministry has placed it under a level-4 travel ban. In 2023 the Korean government evacuated its citizens on military transport planes.
t.know: Sudan has more than 200 pyramids, more than Egypt.
t.etext: It sold gold, sesame, livestock and gum arabic, but the civil war that began in 2023 has destroyed the economy. The pipeline and port that carry South Sudan's oil are there.
